purpose: Predeclared strict direct Kerr-equation checks between Cook author rows on both signed-spin branches, plus the supported-domain edge. These are numerical interpolation controls, not independent author values or a continuous-domain bound.
selection_rule: Evaluate each declared magnitude on both signed branches. The first six lie strictly between Cook rows; 0.9998875 lies between the final supported Cook row 0.999875 and the native domain edge 0.9999; 0.9999 is the supported-domain endpoint. Use native values only as strict solver seeds, never as the comparison answer.
